annotations.text:
The interest is the container.

Every screen carries the interest's own hue — as an orb in the feed rail, a wash behind the interest header, a spine on the media, a dot on a chip. That is the product's premise made visual: you follow subjects, not people.

What changed from the current build:
· a real icon tab bar (there were no icons anywhere)
· media edge-to-edge, no card frame
· compose is the centre tab action, not a pill in the content flow
· Instrument Serif + Schibsted Grotesk, not one weight of system sans
· underline tabs instead of a second row of identical pills
